create_SamplingState: create a SamplingState instance to manage decoded tokens and KV cache state during Gemma sampling
run_prefill: run prefill to initialize KV caches from a prompt and return initial log probabilities and sampling state
run_advance_one_token: run advance_one_token to feed a single sampled token through the model and get updated log probabilities
run_temperature_sample_pyloop: run temperature_sample_pyloop to sample token continuations from a Gemma prompt using a Python for loop
test_sampling_loop: test the simple decoding loop by running prefill and advance_one_token iteratively on a Gemma prompt
